why: Searches confirm the Hadwiger dissection conjecture remains proven only up to dimension 5 (2, 12, 500, and ~12.5 million orthoschemes for dims 2-5 respectively), with no post-2024 source claiming progress on dimension 6 or higher. A 2026 arXiv paper on 'Hadwiger's classification theorem on the sphere via signed orthoscheme decompositions' uses orthoscheme decompositions as a technique but concerns a different Hadwiger theorem (valuations on convex cones), not this dissection conjecture.
